<?php
function forward_ctrl1() {
    echo "ENTER|";
    goto target;
    echo "BAD-OUTER|";
    declare(ticks=0) {
        echo "BAD-INNER|";
        target:
        echo "TARGET|";
    }
    echo "LEAVE|";
    return 13;
}
$value = forward_ctrl1();
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";

<?php
function backward_ctrl1() {
    $tests = 0;
    $count = 0;
    while (($tests = $tests + 1) === 1) {
        declare(ticks=0) {
            echo "PREFIX|";
            target:
            $count = $count + 1;
            echo "COUNT|", $count, "|";
            if ($count < 3) {
                goto target;
            }
            echo "EXIT|";
            break;
        }
    }
    echo "TESTS|", $tests, "|";
    return $count;
}
$value = backward_ctrl1();
echo "RESULT|", $value, "|";
